description.en: Individual portrait sessions in Kraków: film-style portraits, golden hour, motion, shadows and natural light.
description.pl: Sesje indywidualne w Krakowie: portrety w klimacie kina, złota godzina, ruch, cienie i naturalne światło.

alt.en: Sepia portrait of a woman with curly dark hair in the style of an old photograph
